level2.title: Mother of God
level2.story: The shepherds went with haste and found Mary and Joseph, and the infant lying in the manger. They told what they had been told about this child, and everyone wondered. "But Mary kept all these words, pondering them in her heart." The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all they had heard and seen. On the eighth day, He was named Jesus.
level2.keyLine: Mary kept all these words, pondering them in her heart.
